summary: A member that trims locally now also drops superseded resource observations, under the keep-set rule of checkpoint rules version 23: it keeps the newest observation of each attribution, the earliest opener, a pull request's observations back to the newest one outside "open and out of the merge queue", and every observation of a resource in flat facts. The idle nudge's merge-queue walk moves into github_watch as a pure function the trim tests compare between the full and the trimmed log

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; local trim deletes more of this member's own copies, and their IDs go into the retired ledger.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules stay at version 23; this only adds the kind to the local cut.

compatibility.detail: The wire format is unchanged. Envelopes that hold a kept claim stay whole for peers.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade. The first local cut after the upgrade deletes the backlog of superseded resource observations in paced chunks.

manual.detail: No manual step. Freed pages come back through incremental vacuum.

recovery.detail: Reverting stops trimming the kind; what was deleted stays retired and is not re-admitted.
